description: A fault no reader will thank

participation.context: Paid the trade price, held the sheet without improving it, and lifted the pile.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Showed the turned letter, said the sentence, and would not call the price a courtesy.
participation.name: Richard Field

participation.context: Pointed at the blocked passage, and made them move it.
participation.name: Jacqueline Field

relations.note: a changed word has a cost in hours

relations.quote: If both of you have finished discussing paper, one of you may move it.

story.body: You saw what a small fault costs on the stone. You accepted the sentence about three pages. You took the near end of the pile because she asked once. The fourpence halfpenny stayed a purse coin.

relations.note: a changed word has a cost in hours

relations.quote: If both of you have finished discussing paper, one of you may move it.

title: Paid the trade price and moved the pile

participation.context: Saw the ring and the thumb, and did not touch the wet sheet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: His thumb is in the picture. The rest of him has gone on to the next forme.
participation.name: Richard Field

story.body: You looked at the mark and did not add one of your own. The brown stroke is his.
